title: GO Hong Kong Agent liveness representation V1
description: How agent liveness is represented and what it may not claim. The mechanism already exists: a CONTROL_PLANE_HEALTH Task, already in the agent ALLOWLIST, whose executor path is read-only (uname nodename, /proc/meminfo, disk free) and whose result is published as ordinary signed Evidence. This contract adds no Hong Kong code and no monitoring system.

evidence_shape.description: Payload carried by the signed Evidence for this action.

freshness_window_seconds.description: age <= this -> PROVEN; age > this -> UNKNOWN, never PROVEN. It is deliberately larger than the probe interval: a probe issued exactly on schedule still has to travel GitHub -> Bridge -> Hong Kong -> Evidence -> Projection, and a window equal to the interval would declare the agent stale for the whole time its own Evidence is in flight.

probe_interval_seconds.description: The producer's own cadence. The freshness window is this plus the transport grace, and neither the interval nor the daily probe budget is raised to buy freshness.

transport_grace_seconds.description: Delivery slack only. It is not a second way to infer liveness: ONLINE still requires signature-verified Evidence inside the window, and SSH success, an HTTP 200 or a past Task success never substitute for it.

PROVEN.const: signature-verified liveness Evidence whose completed_at is inside the freshness window

OBSERVED.const: liveness Evidence inside the window whose signature was not checked in this run

UNKNOWN.const: no liveness Evidence, or the newest liveness Evidence is older than the window

default: a successful VERIFY / TEST_PR / DEPLOY task is not proof that the agent is online now
a newer Evidence timestamp does not prove the current process is alive
NULL from a failed liveness probe does not prove the agent is dead
the projection must never synthesise a heartbeat the agent did not sign
activity is not liveness: the newest CONTROL_PLANE_HEALTH Evidence at any age answers 'when did we last hear from it', never 'is it online now'

two_questions_not_one.hk_agent_recent_activity: the newest signed CONTROL_PLANE_HEALTH Evidence, at any age. OBSERVED (or PROVEN once its signature verified). Always answerable once any probe exists.
two_questions_not_one.hk_agent_online: PROVEN only from liveness Evidence inside the freshness window; otherwise UNKNOWN with last_seen and age_seconds attached.
two_questions_not_one.note: Never answer the second question with the first one.

secret_leakage.const: none: the payload contains no credential, path or token

cost.const: one signed Task + one signed Evidence per probe, on the existing repositories

properties.x-go-gap: The producer and the Signer path both exist and are installed: agent-liveness-producer-v1 places a bounded read-only CONTROL_PLANE_HEALTH Request in its outbox on a timer, and the Boss Request Bridge can now sign that action, so a probe really does reach the agent and come back as signed Evidence (one-shot end-to-end proven 2026-09-15). What is still an operator step is the relay from the outbox to a Request on the control bus. While no fresh probe exists, answers.hk_agent_online honestly reads UNKNOWN even though the agent is healthy, because the control bus carries no fresh liveness Evidence.
